## Introduction

This report presents an exploratory data analysis of the accident dataset.

## Data Overview

```{r data-overview}
# Load processed data
processed_files <- list.files(
  path = here("data", "processed"),
  pattern = "_cleaned\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

data_list <- list()
for (file in processed_files) {
  name <- str_replace(basename(file), "_cleaned\\.rds$", "")
  data_list[[name]] <- readRDS(file)
}
```

### Dataset Dimensions

```{r dataset-dimensions}
# Create summary table
dim_summary <- tibble(
  Dataset = names(data_list),
  Rows = map_int(data_list, nrow),
  Columns = map_int(data_list, ncol)
)

dim_summary %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Dataset Dimensions")
```

## Data Quality

### Missing Data

```{r missing-data}
# Analyze missing data for each dataset
for (name in names(data_list)) {
  df <- data_list[[name]]
  if (any(is.na(df))) {
    cat("\n###", name, "\n\n")
    missing_summary <- df %>%
      summarise_all(~sum(is.na(.))) %>%
      pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Missing") %>%
      filter(Missing > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(Missing))
    
    if (nrow(missing_summary) > 0) {
      print(knitr::kable(missing_summary))
    }
  }
}
```
